Diffstat reports 23 files changed (threshold for XXL is 16+); the high count is driven by an extensive test suite expansion across repository, service, and router layers alongside the three core implementation files.

The lazy-refresh pattern (check staleness, fetch from LiteLLM, persist, fall back to DB) is well-established in this codebase.
